kitDescription: Neon: Vision Eye is an Electric rocket-launcher attacker whose damage comes almost entirely from a rider on her charged shots: every full-charge rocket that lands on the stage target deals an extra 437.98% of her final ATK as additional damage. She runs a personal 'Firepower Gauge' that starts the fight full (100). When she bursts at a full gauge she enters Super Firepower — Attack Damage +45.03%, an extra +35.05% ATK on the Full Burst, and a second +262.79%-of-ATK rider on each charged shot — and the gauge empties. When she bursts on an empty-ish gauge she instead opens a 10-second Firepower Charge that refills the gauge (+1 on cast, +2 per shot, +45 when it ends), which takes two such rotations to top back up; so Super Firepower lands on her 1st, 4th, 7th… burst. Independently of the gauge, every one of her bursts gives her Attack Damage +110.21% for 10s and a bigger explosion radius, and every team Full Burst entry gives her ATK +80.04% for 10s. Her Skill 1 also carries a purely defensive package (brief invulnerability and debuff immunity when hit, plus a self healing-received buff) that does nothing offensively.

redAssertions: S2e '+35.05% ATK Super rider' — asserts the apply frame is a fullBurstStart frame; the driver applies it at her burstCast (~22f / 0.37s earlier). Real (low-severity) trigger-identity divergence from the kit wording 'when entering Full Burst'. All sibling assertions in the group passed (present, every-3rd cadence, magnitude 35.05, not merged into 115.09, self-scoped).

S2d 'burstGenPct self-buff at full-burst end' — the driver deliberately UNMODELS the 5%×gauge burst-generation line (documented verbatim in override.unmodeled.skill2). Fable S2b independently graded the same line GAP; the S6 blind modeled it only with a self-declared placeholder magnitude (75). DOCUMENTED_GAP, not a defect.

S1b 'the +262.79% rider co-lands on some charges' — heuristic counts frames carrying ≥2 damage events with srcSlot==='skill1'. The driver routes the Super rider through the SSOT-sanctioned `extraHitDamagePct` primitive, whose rider emits srcSlot=null in the 'burst' bucket, so the heuristic reads doubled=0. The rider is present and correct (driver test N2 pins the buff, the per-shot burst-bucket rider, critEligible, coreEligible=false). RECON_ERROR — an encoding-shape assumption in the blind test, not a missing line.

gotchas.summary: The Super-Firepower ATK +35.05% rider is applied on her burst CAST rather than on Full Burst ENTRY as the kit states, shifting its 10s window ~22 frames early.
gotchas.evidence: Kit skill2: '■ Activates when entering Full Burst. Affects self. Maximum Firepower … Additional effect for Super Firepower: ATK ▲ 35.05% for 10 sec.' Mechanics SSOT: a burstCast resolves BEFORE the Full Burst window opens (~22f/0.37s for this unit). Driver encodes 35.05 inside the skill1 burstCast everyN:3/offset:1 Super block; the S5 blind test's frame-identity assertion (apply frame ∈ fullBurstStart) fails against it. The S6 blind used fullBurstEnter+everyN:3/offset:1 instead, but its own ⚑8 concedes that keying drifts out of phase with her own burst count whenever another Burst III takes a rotation.
gotchas.suggestedFix: No magnitude change. Either (a) document the deviation in the override note — 'the 35.05 Super rider is keyed to her burstCast rather than fullBurstEnter because the engine has no time-windowed self-status gate; this starts/ends the 10s window ~22f early, a marginal under-credit, and preserves correct phase in multi-B3 comps' — or (b) add the missing primitive (a fullBurstEnter trigger with a self-status/`requiresOwnBuff` gate on the Super window) and re-key it, which is the only fully faithful representation of the kit wording. Option (a) is sufficient for GO; option (b) is the durable fix and would also let the 262.79 rider gate on the status rather than on the cast counter.

verdictRationale: Fourteen of fifteen kit lines are FAITHFUL or DOCUMENTED_GAP, and the one exception is a low-severity FIDELITY note, not a behavioural error: the +35.05% Super ATK rider is keyed to her burst cast instead of Full Burst entry, which shifts a 10s window by ~22 frames (she fires nothing in that gap; the net is a marginal under-credit) and is undocumented — the fix is a note, or a new time-windowed self-status gate if the owner wants the literal encoding. Ranked below that: the deliberately unmodeled FB-end burst-gen line (5%×gauge), where the two blinds split — fable independently graded it GAP, the S6 blind modeled it only with an admitted placeholder magnitude of 75 — so the driver's documented skip is the MEASURED>FUDGE-correct call, with the honest residual that her burst generation on charge rotations is under-credited. The three blind-test reds are therefore one real low finding, one documented gap, and one RECON_ERROR (the blind's doubled-events heuristic assumed the Super rider would be a second srcSlot='skill1' flatDamage; the driver uses the SSOT-sanctioned extraHitDamagePct, whose rider is srcSlot=null in the burst bucket — the rider is present and pinned). A second recon note: the S6 blind's ⚑4 claim that target:'enemy' resolves to an empty target set is refuted by the driver's live run, where the 437.98 rider lands once per shot. Both blinds re-derived the period-3 / phase-1 Super cycle independently from gauge arithmetic and converged with the driver and with the video-verified kit-status, so the cadence — the load-bearing mechanic and the biggest available over-credit if dropped (Super on every burst would be a ~3× inflation of the 45.03/35.05/262.79 package) — is corroborated three ways and pinned by exact frames, not just counts. Discrimination is adequate: every load-bearing line has a counterfactual that fails under its nearest-wrong model, and the one gap in the driver's own fixture (sole-B3, so burstCast and fullBurstEnter coincide and trigger KIND is untestable) is covered by the S5 blind's helm co-B3 fixture, where the driver's fullBurstEnter-keyed 80.04 and burstCast-keyed 110.21/45.03 all pass. Same-model residuals for the owner to spot-check: (1) that the 262.79 rider's 'burst'-bucket routing via extraHitDamagePct receives the same majors/flavors the kit's Firepower-Explosion wording implies (both blinds and the driver are the same model family and all leaned on the primer's sanction here); (2) the ~7-shots-per-charge-window estimate, which is an ⚑ that does not move the period but does set the size of the skipped burst-gen buff; and (3) the Explosion Radius ▲200% skip — inert against a partless boss by construction, but the first suspect if a recording ever shows her in-burst hit or core rate rising. Process note, not faithfulness: all three blind roles independently reported that the supplied redacted schema leaked a unit-named comment on everyNOffset; each re-derived the cycle without it, and the packet-prep script should strip unit-named schema comments.
